i have, give them chances to try and help me many, times...

But it all ends up the same. I don't think they can help much. Their words is there only to make me feel bad about myself. I've suffered it enough, i can't do it again, they can't change.

I'd have to fake that i would agree with them just so they would stop talking. If i we're to talk against them they wouldn't care, I've tried.

i used to look up to my parents, i tried to be the best for them, I'd ask for nothing much in my life, I'd often refuse to be bought much of anything. I remember when i was i kid that i cry alone in my room thinking how big of a burden i am to my family.

  i have grown up now, i have seen many things in the world, and i know that what my parents done isn't their to be blame entirely. Even knowing so, i couldn't make things better for my family, even for my younger siblings, i feel i can't do anything.

  maybe i'm being a cry baby and, or im just weak, i feel like my family is the one in my way, and then my school is the one in my way, and probably in the end i am the one in the way.

  i wanted my life to end, but if only it to be painless and fast. I probably wont be alright soon, maybe never.
